_comment: Provenance pin for the one file in this slug copied from the authors' release, their BNGL model
from Supplementary Software 1, vendored byte-identical under reference/; check_author_file.py
refuses to run if its sha256 differs. The Source Data workbook is pinned but not vendored
(5.8 MB); extract_exp.py refuses a copy whose sha256 differs. Everything else in the slug is
written here. VERIFY: sha256(file bytes) == sha256.
publication: Kirsch K, Zeke A, Toke O, Sok P, Sethi A, Sebo A, Kumar GS, Egri P, Poti AL, Gooley P, Peti W, Bento I, Alexa A, Remenyi A (2020). Co-regulation of the transcription controlling ATF2 phosphoswitch by JNK and p38. Nat Commun 11:5769. doi:10.1038/s41467-020-19582-3 (PMC7666158)

source_data.used: Sheet Figure_4 (Fig. 4a): columns B (t, min), C (WT) and D (WT + JNK-IN-8), mean rows 6-24 and error rows 29-47. Cell C27 says the error rows are 'calculated with error propagation from the standard error of treated and untreated samples (n=3)', i.e. propagated standard errors, though the block is headed SD.

reference/upstream_Bionetgen_JNK-p38-ATF.role: The authors' rule-based model for WT ATF2 (their ReadMe: 'used for generating Figure_7b'), with its own actions block: 20000 s equilibration with kstim7 and kstim6 set to the basal keq7 = 4.695e-6 and keq6 = 1.74e-5, then 2400 s of anisomycin stimulation at kstim7 = 9.074e-5 and kstim6 = 1.16e-4.
